exact_path_candidates.title: The recurring three-file compaction is on cadence; residuals from the third pass
exact_path_candidates.why: The cadence rule in CLAUDE.md compacts AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and README.md every 2-3 waves. DOCS-COMPACT (wave 16) and DOCS-COMPACT-2 (wave 23) are the precedents; DOCS-COMPACT-3 ran after wave 26 - three waves on, the cadence honoured - and records the NEXT PASS AS DUE AROUND WAVE 29. The load-bearing check is the standing-constraint inventory, verified MECHANICALLY rather than by reading: 39 entries before, 39 after, zero dropped, zero added, ZERO RENUMBERED, with 37 bodies byte-identical after whitespace normalisation and the two reworded ones (constraint 7's leak narrative, constraint 14's keyword ledger) argued clause by clause; 6 hard invariants identical; 87 evidence pointers in and 87 out; 93 diagnostic codes in and 94 out, none lost and Q088 gained by becoming individually searchable. Renumbering was ruled out TWICE, once by the inventory and once by a census finding six Rust files that cite AGENTS.md constraints BY NUMBER. AGENTS.md gained 10 lines while LOSING 796 bytes, which is the honest shape of the pass - constraint 14 became a per-card ledger, more lines and far less re-reading - and constraints 15e-15i were read line by line and DELIBERATELY NOT COMPACTED, because nearly every sentence is a rule, a 'do not' or a named residual whose only other home is a card report. README.md was REFRESHED rather than compacted, to the full route surface it had fallen behind (std.socket including declared addresses, std.http, the string composition band, the counted loop and its checked-never-trusted unroll licence, the reactor composition, and the CT row in the ledger's own vocabulary). ONE DRIFT WAS CORRECTED: the entry points listed the configured-audit command twice, once wrongly as `qcore-audit CONFIG.json`; crates/qcore-audit/Cargo.toml declares the binary `quirin-audit`, and qcore-audit is the PACKAGE AND LIBRARY name, unchanged by the Quirin rename - a documentation drift, not a rename. Every other headline number was re-read from its source and AGREED with what the wave-26 close set. New: DOCS-COMPACT-3-WORKTREE-SUBMODULE - in a fresh worktree with third_party/libevent uninitialised, profile_loader's pin check reports the SUPERPROJECT's HEAD as the submodule's `actual` revision, so the failure reads as a pin violation by whatever commit is at HEAD (here, the card's own documentation commit). The pin is intact and the test is correct to fail; only the message misleads, and a one-line 'is the submodule initialised?' precondition would turn a scary diagnostic into an accurate one. Not fixed by a card that touches no test, and filed for a separate session. Carried: DOCS-COMPACT-2-W4-DESIGN-POINTER (see LOADER-ABI-O) and the observation that AGENTS.md is AT ITS FLOOR for this method - three passes in, the remaining large entries are rule text whose only other home is their card reports, so a fourth pass should expect to find its material in whatever waves 27-29 append and should NOT cut to hit a number. The examples spelling rule this card also carried is in EXAMPLES-SUITE-O, with its one open case EXAMPLES-STYLE-SLICE-FANOUT.

exact_path_candidates.title: The provider workspace's `cargo test` is now the gate's longest Rust step: 370.3 s, against 219.6 s for the root suite through the runner
exact_path_candidates.why: In card W44-TEST-SUITE-WALL-TIME's gate, run on the same tree at 1-minute load about 25 on 16 CPUs, `cargo test --manifest-path providers/Cargo.toml --workspace --locked --offline --no-fail-fast` took 370.3 s, build included (124 passed over 39 summaries). The root suite took 219.6 s through scripts/run_test_binaries.py, build included (docs/reports/w44-test-suite-wall-time/gate-facts.json). The runner deliberately refuses the provider workspace. Its conformance binaries launch process providers under declared timeouts throughout. `configured_audit::pinned_second_codebase_runs_configured_process_checks_without_a_rust_import_adapter` (a 5 s plugin quota) and constraint 16's `packages` rows are load-sensitive. So every one of them would have to run exclusively, and the per-binary split of the 370 s was not measured. DISCHARGE: time the provider suite per binary. If the time sits in binaries that launch no process provider, extend the runner's EXCLUSIVE audit to that workspace with the same fail-closed checks and publish equivalence. Otherwise record why it stays serial.

exact_path_candidates.title: The census-sink guard runs only under --features indirect-census in CI, and main was red on it for a stretch of waves 44-45
exact_path_candidates.why: MEASURED by card STABILITY-REEVAL-5 (wave-45 close, base 8c1f15eb): every_declared_sink_forces_one_job (crates/qcore-c-gateway/src/lib.rs, cfg(all(test, feature="indirect-census")), added by the integrator at fc0fafcb) runs in .github/workflows/ci.yml:37 only; docs/agents/validation.md:14-20 runs no feature build. Per the step-3 sub-audit, the sink added at 66ce7c7f was unlisted until 5b7942bb, noticed only by card gates (w45-return-expression-families/README.md:305, w45-sub-object-stores/README.md:315,:362, w45-callee-summary-cascade/README.md:498-502). DISCHARGE: the standing gate or runner includes `cargo test -p qcore-c-gateway --features indirect-census --lib`, or the rule says it is CI-only and a close checks CI.
